courses.summary: 邦加是奈及利亞深水油氣開發案例；課程以既有浮式處理中心的延伸使用分析容量和檢驗證據。本課依序分析延伸服務的分離負荷、新增來油與緩衝、長期服役接口、海上修復等待、循環歷史與延續使用，每項都包含可重算模型、證據規劃、故障辨析與驗收成果。數字全部是教學假設；不宣稱本案例採用這些設備參數。
courses.summaryEn: Bonga is a Nigerian deepwater development; this case analyses capacity and inspection evidence for continued use of a floating hub. The course analyses separation duty during extended service, additional feed and buffering, long-service interfaces, offshore repair waiting, cycle history and continued use, with recalculable models, evidence plans, fault discrimination and acceptance artifacts. All numbers are teaching assumptions; no plant-specific parameter is asserted.
